pages.title: Spin Network Loom
pages.text: Weaves quanta of area and volume into a spin network: space, a grain at a time.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 4$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
Weaves Planck Shards into Planck Area Tiles, tiles into Spin Network Nodes, and nodes with liquid spacetime into Quantum Spacetime Condensate.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 1 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Planck Area Tile, Quantum Spacetime Condensate, Spin Network Node.
